name: Galaxy Prophet
source:
By a trap of fate, you are transported to a distant galaxy where the villagers take the sign of your arrival as an important part of the fulfillment of an ancient prophecy.

The uncertainty, however, grows with the confirmation of two facts: the alleged heroine arrived too early and; she must be someone native to that galaxy.

Will you help the locals to unravel this mystery? Do you prefer to return home in the certainty that this is all a huge mistake?

Think carefully before making a decision, as every choice has a consequence.

[Translated from [url=https://deubug.itch.io/galaxy01]itch.io[/url]]
